summary: Stinnett called Netanyahu and hardliners 'guilty in plain sight of genocide of the Palestinian people' in August 2026 and said in September he would vote against continued U.S. funding to Israel until Netanyahu is replaced and Israel makes restitution. He explicitly names the killing as genocide and opposes American financial support, but frames the remedy around Netanyahu's removal and Israeli restitution rather than a broader break with the U.S.-Israel relationship.
